about: The postcommunion of the Third Sunday of Advent asks that divine help cleanse us of our faults and prepare us for the coming feasts.

seg.tr: We implore Your mercy, Lord: may this divine help cleanse us of our faults and prepare us for the coming feasts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who liveth and reigneth with Thee
